description: This PHP file contains the 'Coupon' controller class for the Opencart admin interface, handling CRUD operations, listing, enabling, disabling, and history management for marketing coupons.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing coupons in the Opencart admin panel, providing methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and viewing coupon history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the list view of coupons.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to get the list of coupons, outputs HTML view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of coupons, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a coupon.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing coupon, performs validation, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a specific coupon.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and generates HTML for the history entries of a particular coupon.
